posts.title: RISC-V: The New Kid on the Chip
posts.description: RISC-V is a new instruction set architecture ( ISA ). To be extremely accurate, RISC-V is a family of ISAs, but it is common to refer to them as the RISC-V ISA. An ISA specifies the behaviors a given CPU manufacturer's processor implementation must exhibit in order to maintain binary compatibility with other implementations.
